eps.ov: An amnesiac named Elle enters Los Angeles, carrying only a locked data device that may hold the secrets of her past.
Haunted by traumatic memories, Elle recognizes a familiar face. Upon tracking him down she uncovers a shocking truth about herself and her memories.
With help from the mysterious J, Elle learns more startling truths about the nature of her identity…
Elle's memories come flooding back, revealing the truth of what happened to her in the desert. Meanwhile, LAPD Officer Davis puts together the clues that will lead her to Black Lotus.
Elle plots her revenge with help from J, but Police Chief Grant has mobilized a massive LAPD manhunt to find and eliminate her.
In her quest for revenge, Elle breaks into the home of her next target and is forced to take a hostage. Chief Grant calls in reinforcements.
After learning J's shameful secret, Elle leaves to complete her mission: to kill the last of the Doll Hunt participants.
Frustrated that no one believes her theory about Black Lotus, Officer Davis lands in hot water while presenting her findings to the department.
Elle goes after the final target to complete her mission of revenge, the man responsible for the Doll Hunt.
As Elle struggles with not knowing which of her memories are real and which are artificial, J opens up about his own past.
Desperately lost and searching for peace, Elle hatches a radical plan to put her haunted memories to rest.
While Elle has her first encounter with a dangerous new foe, J has his final encounter with his former colleague Marlowe.
Left with no other option, Elle faces off against the architect of her suffering.
